The terms grant no right to reverse engineer the service and prohibit using the service or its contents to generate, train, fine-tune, or otherwise develop another machine learning model, including by distillation or extraction, which is what forecloses recovering the post-training from the endpoint. They govern output separately from weights: as between the parties the user owns its outputs, while the user grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to its content, and content is used for model training by default with a non-retrospective opt-out in the console. The service is unavailable in the EU, EEA, UK, and Switzerland pending GDPR work, and the terms set Japanese law with exclusive Tokyo District Court jurisdiction for users in Japan and California law with AAA arbitration seated in Los Angeles for everyone else. A separately incorporated Usage Policy, effective 21 July 2026, is incorporated by reference and restricts surveillance, CBRNE, cyberattack, election-interference, and unapproved security-evaluation uses.

access_boundary: This record represents the `sakana-namazu-v1.0` release, the fixed model ID Sakana AI's console documents as the current version of its Japanese-specialized line, launched with the API announcement of 3 August 2026. The `sakana-namazu` alias, which the console states points to the latest version and currently resolves to v1.0, is a moving name rather than a second release. The Fugu, Fugu Ultra, Fugu Max, and Fugu Cyber models are separate multi-agent orchestration releases that Sakana explicitly contrasts with this one, the March 2026 Namazu alpha prototypes built on DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus, Llama 3.1, and gpt-oss-120B are a superseded lineage, the underlying Kimi K2.6 weights are Moonshot AI's release and not Sakana AI's, and the LEAP-style on-premises customization stack Sakana sells is a separate product boundary.
strengths: Sakana AI documents a versioned model ID, the alias that moves to it, a 256K context window, image input by URL or base64, document input to 4 MB, and structured output with text, json_object, and json_schema
The release is a single in-house model rather than an orchestration layer, which Sakana's own console states directly when it contrasts Namazu with Fugu

Governing terms, a separate usage policy, and a published per-token price page are all first-party and dated, and the API is documented across Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages styles with built-in web search and code execution
tradeoffs: No weights are published and the terms prohibit reverse engineering and any training or distillation from the service, so the post-training cannot be inspected or reproduced
Content is used for model training by default and the opt-out is not retroactive, while the user grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, sublicensable licence to its content

The service is not available in the EU, EEA, UK, or Switzerland while Sakana works toward GDPR compliance, and the model ID is versioned without a published deprecation or retirement policy for the line
